name: Nuclear risk
summary: No US–Russia arms-control limits since New START expired; North Korea tests new warheads
state: New START expired in February 2026 with no replacement treaty. North Korea tested a cruise missile with a new cluster warhead in a launch reported on 2 Nov, after October tests of missiles it describes as nuclear-capable (Arms Control Association). No nuclear test or change in alert levels had been reported as of 4 Nov.

sources.title: Arms Control Association — North Korea and South Korea launch missiles amid tensions

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
